name: Held requests and asks
what: When a rule holds a request, only that request waits, and the computer keeps running. You get an ask in the Silo app that shows, in Silo's words, exactly what your yes would let pass, and your yes lets it pass. A hold has a limit that Silo keeps itself, and when it ends without your answer the request is refused as held and not answered.

suggest.why: Without a hold a rule can only allow or deny, so everything you want to look at first has to be denied and retried by hand.
